name: Prepared Spellbook
description: Owns which spells each party member knows and prepares, plus the remaining prepared casts per slot tier. A dispatched cast order is checked before Hotbar Abilities sees it: unknown, unprepared, or exhausted requests are rejected without cooldown, damage, or resource payment. A successful combat.abilityCast then spends exactly one matching prepared cast by correlation id; a Hotbar rejection spends nothing. Completed rest replenishes those casts without changing the preparation list, and an interrupted rest emits no recovery event. A completed rest must carry a stable restId: processedRestIds makes replayed completion silent, and initialProcessedRestIds restores that ledger without replaying restoration events.

inputs.name: spellCatalog
inputs.description: Original game data: [{id, tier, tags?}]. Empty means no spells are known until the host supplies a catalog; no commercial spell names or tables are embedded.

inputs.name: knownSpellsByMember
inputs.description: Known spell ids keyed by party-member id. Knowledge is distinct from preparation.

inputs.name: initialPreparation
inputs.description: Prepared spell ids keyed by member and slot tier. Rest restores casts of this list rather than silently replacing it.

inputs.name: slotCapacityByTier
inputs.description: Maximum prepared casts per member and tier, supplied by the host's progression rules.

inputs.name: recoverOnRest
inputs.description: Whether world.restCompleted restores prepared casts. False supports cooldown-only or survival variants.

inputs.name: initialProcessedRestIds
inputs.description: Completed rest ids already consumed by this spellbook; prevents a restored or redelivered world.restCompleted from replenishing casts twice.

outputs.name: preparedByMember
outputs.description: Current preparation lists by member and tier.

outputs.name: remainingCastsByMember
outputs.description: Remaining casts for each prepared spell and tier.

outputs.name: canCast
outputs.description: Synchronous check for known, prepared, and remaining-cast eligibility; it does not replace Hotbar range or cooldown checks.

outputs.name: processedRestIds
outputs.description: Durable completed-rest dedupe ledger for per-rest cast recovery.

provenance: BG2-inspired extraction pass on 2026-11-02 searched Hotbar Abilities, Cooldown, Energy Per Turn, Rest Camp, Skills Tree and Spell-related descriptors. Hotbar owns cast execution and cooldowns, Rest Camp owns the completed-versus-interrupted rest transaction, and the other systems own unrelated resource or progression rules. No component owned known-versus-prepared spell state or rest-recovered cast counts, so this adds that state and authorizes rather than executes casts.
